title: This Free Tool Cuts Your Claude Agent's Token Usage by 92%
description:
Your Claude agent isn't slow because it's dumb — it's slow because it's reading a mountain of text before it even answers. Headroom is a free open-source tool that sits between your AI agent and everything it reads, compressing tool outputs, logs, and files before they hit the model. Real results: code search dropped from 17,765 tokens to 1,408 (92% saved), SRE debugging went from 65,000 tokens to 5,000. One command — headroom wrap claude — and you're running. Works with Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot. Same answers, fraction of the cost. Comment 'tokens' and I'll send you the link

#claude #codex #aitools #headroom
